name: MK19.8 /connections loads all nine connection modules
MK19.8 each module is mounted on the page (auth form, data.gov.au search, URL import, manager, cache and rate-limit status)
MK19.8 the page says plainly that, with no allowlist, connections are refused by it
MK19.8 Load as Dataset waits for a parsed response, and says nothing is unimplemented
MK19.8 a data.gov.au search with no allowlist shows the allowlist refusal, not results
js: await (async()=>{document.getElementById('datagov-query').value='road';document.getElementById('datagov-search-btn').click();for(let i=0;i<50;i++){const s=document.getElementById('datagov-status').textContent;if(/refused by moke’s proxy \(403\): host not on the proxy allowlist \(MOKE_PROXY_ALLOW\): data\.gov\.au/.test(s))return document.getElementById('datagov-results').children.length===0;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));}return document.getElementById('datagov-status').textContent;})()

name: MK19.8 the search went to moke's /api/proxy, never to data.gov.au directly, with the /data/api/3/action base
MK19.8 a URL import with no allowlist shows the refusal and its reason
js: await (async()=>{const before=sessionStorage.getItem('moke_dataset');document.getElementById('url-import-form_urlimport_url').value='https://data.example.org/towns.csv';document.getElementById('url-import-form_urlimport_btn').click();for(let i=0;i<50;i++){const s=document.getElementById('url-import-form_urlimport_status').textContent;if(/not on the proxy allowlist \(MOKE_PROXY_ALLOW\): data\.example\.org/.test(s))return sessionStorage.getItem('moke_dataset')===before;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));}return document.getElementById('url-import-form_urlimport_status').textContent;})()

js: await (async()=>{const card=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#mcm-list .mcm-card')).find(c=>/Towns/.test(c.textContent));card.querySelector('.mcm-btn-test').click();for(let i=0;i<50;i++){const m=card.querySelector('.mcm-msg').textContent;if(/refused by moke’s proxy \(403\): host not on the proxy allowlist \(MOKE_PROXY_ALLOW\): api\.example\.org/.test(m))return true;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));}return card.querySelector('.mcm-msg').textContent;})()

name: MK19.8 the manager's Load is refused too, and loads nothing
js: await (async()=>{const before=sessionStorage.getItem('moke_dataset');const card=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#mcm-list .mcm-card')).find(c=>/Towns/.test(c.textContent));card.querySelector('.mcm-btn-load').click();for(let i=0;i<50;i++){const m=card.querySelector('.mcm-msg').textContent;if(/not on the proxy allowlist/.test(m))return sessionStorage.getItem('moke_dataset')===before && location.pathname==='/connections';await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));}return card.querySelector('.mcm-msg').textContent;})()

name: MK19.8 a refused Test leaves Load as Dataset disabled
js: await (async()=>{document.getElementById('btn-test').click();for(let i=0;i<50;i++){if(/not on the proxy allowlist/.test(document.getElementById('resp-body-body').textContent))return document.getElementById('btn-load-dataset').disabled===true && document.getElementById('parse-preview').textContent==='';await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));}return document.getElementById('resp-body-body').textContent;})()

name: MK19.8 CANNED ENVELOPE (a success the proxy cannot produce for a loopback stand-in): Test parses it and enables Load
js: await (async()=>{const real=window.fetch;window.__cannedSeen=[];window.fetch=async(u,i)=>{if(u==='/api/proxy'){window.__cannedSeen.push(JSON.parse(i.body).url);return new Response(JSON.stringify({ok:true,status:200,contentType:'application/json',body:JSON.stringify({results:[{suburb:'Sandy Bay',count:7},{suburb:'Battery Point',count:3}]})}),{status:200,headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}});}return real(u,i);};document.getElementById('btn-test').click();for(let i=0;i<50;i++){const p=document.getElementById('parse-preview').textContent;if(/Parsed 2 rows × 2 columns/.test(p))return document.getElementById('btn-load-dataset').disabled===false && window.__cannedSeen.join()==='https://api.example.org/towns';await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));}return document.getElementById('parse-preview').textContent;})()

name: MK19.8 Load as Dataset (canned) goes to the chat
MK19.8 /chat has the loaded table as the one active dataset, in the store's shape
js: (()=>{const d=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('moke_dataset'));return location.pathname==='/chat' && d.name==='Towns' && d.headers.join()==='suburb,count' && JSON.stringify(d.rows)==='[["Sandy Bay","7"],["Battery Point","3"]]' && d.sensitivity==='INTERNAL' && d.source.kind==='connection' && d.source.connection==='Towns' && Object.keys(sessionStorage).filter(k=>/api_response/.test(k)).length===0;})()

name: MK19.8 live refresh did not start by itself on the way back (it is never the demo path)
MK19.8 LIVE REFRESH, demonstrated separately (CANNED ENVELOPE): a refresh of the active dataset's connection replaces it through MokeActive.load
js: await (async()=>{const real=window.fetch;window.__realFetch=real;window.fetch=async(u,i)=>{if(u==='/api/proxy'){return new Response(JSON.stringify({ok:true,status:200,contentType:'application/json',body:JSON.stringify({results:[{suburb:'Sandy Bay',count:9},{suburb:'Battery Point',count:4},{suburb:'Taroona',count:1}]})}),{status:200,headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}});}return real(u,i);};await MokeConnectionManager.refresh('Towns');for(let i=0;i<50;i++){const l=document.getElementById('live-refresh-log').textContent;if(/Live refresh of “Towns” replaced the active dataset \(3 rows\)/.test(l)){const d=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('moke_dataset'));return d.rows.length===3 && d.rows[0][1]==='9' && d.sensitivity==='INTERNAL' && d.source.connection==='Towns';}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));}return document.getElementById('live-refresh-log').textContent;})()

name: MK19.8 through the real proxy (no allowlist), a live refresh is refused with its reason and the active dataset is untouched
js: await (async()=>{window.fetch=window.__realFetch;const before=sessionStorage.getItem('moke_dataset');await MokeConnectionManager.refresh('Towns');return /Live refresh of “Towns” not fetched: refused by moke’s proxy \(403\): host not on the proxy allowlist \(MOKE_PROXY_ALLOW\): api\.example\.org/.test(document.getElementById('live-refresh-log').textContent) && sessionStorage.getItem('moke_dataset')===before;})()
